name: Tycherosi
tagline: Sun-warmed trader out of the southern isles
description: Tycheros is a warm, seafaring stretch of the Shattered Isles known for trade, music, and a lucrative, well-organized smuggling trade — Tycherosi in Duskvol are disproportionately found on the docks, in dockside taverns, and (whispered) in the Hawkers' own ranks.
